verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Chargebee subscriptions can incorporate coupons and discounts (chargebee-docs-26), and dunning/retry emails exist for payment recovery (chargebee-docs-11, chargebee-docs-12), but there is no documentation of free-trial configuration, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or card-network-mandated trial-end notifications. Missing for 10: trial period setup/config docs, promotion code (distinct from coupon) support, automatic conversion mechanics, and trial-end reminder/notification compliance features.
